data_description.area_id: Each area can be set up only once.

abort.already_configured: This area is already set up.

data_description.ring_until_acknowledged: The timer stays "ringing" after it runs out, until it is acknowledged. Off: it is gone right after the finished event.
data_description.reminder_minutes: While a timer rings, a reminder event every so many minutes. 0: no reminders.
data_description.auto_dismiss_minutes: A ringing timer is acknowledged by itself after so many minutes. 0: it rings until acknowledged.
data_description.report_missed: A timer that ran out while Home Assistant was restarting is reported right after the start (finished event with "late"). Off: it is dropped.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts a timer in an area.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the timer is for, e.g. "Let dough rest".

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional text that goes with the timer's events, e.g. for the notification.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional data of the caller (a script, another integration); returned in every event of the timer.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, from the start action's response, an event (timer_id) or the area sensor's timers attribute.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, from the start action's response, an event (timer_id) or the area sensor's timers attribute.

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Adds time to a timer. A ringing timer starts again with the added time.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, from the start action's response, an event (timer_id) or the area sensor's timers attribute.

subtract_time.name: Subtract time
subtract_time.description: Takes time off a timer. Down to zero, it runs out.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, from the start action's response, an event (timer_id) or the area sensor's timers attribute.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How much time to take off.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels a timer, whatever its state.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, from the start action's response, an event (timer_id) or the area sensor's timers attribute.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Acknowledges a ringing timer, or all ringing timers of the targeted areas.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer to acknowledge. Without it, all ringing timers of the targeted areas.

invalid_duration.message: The duration must be longer than zero.

unknown_timer.message: There is no timer with the id {timer_id} (anymore).

ringing.message: The timer "{name}" is ringing; acknowledge it or add time.

area_not_set_up.message: The area {area} is not set up in Home Timer.

not_a_home_timer_device.message: The device {device} does not belong to Home Timer.

one_area.message: Choose exactly one area (or its Home Timer device) for the timer.

timer_or_area.message: Give a timer id or choose an area.
